as_told.title: 'Dog whistle' brings UAP in day after day

plain: There is a signal or device called the "dog whistle", and when it is switched on, UFOs show up day after day. That is what a man named Jake Barber, who says he has seen it work, tells Michels: "After we turn on the dog whistle, UAPs literally come to us day after day." UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. A second witness, James Valor, says nearly the same words on an episode about Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs. Valor credits the claim to someone he calls Mr. K and dates the work to 2021 to 2025. If it were true, it would mean these objects can be called in on purpose instead of just waited for.
